content.headline: One notice → four audiences in minutes
content.body: Copy a structured MahaTransco outage advisory, open ChatGPT or Claude, then iterate: Marathi, Hindi, WhatsApp, and a short social post. Judgment stays with you — retyping dies.
bullets: Scenario: planned transmission-related outage advisory for citizens
Follow-ups: Marathi → Hindi → WhatsApp (<40 words) → X/Twitter (<280)
Ask the room: would you sign a cleaned version of the English draft?
